extracted.intended_audience: prospective applicants to ARPA-E OPEN 2021 (DE-FOA-0002459) — PIs, startups, universities, national labs, and other organizations preparing Concept Papers and Full Applications
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and FAQ for preparing and submitting Concept Papers and Full Applications to ARPA-E FOA DE-FOA-0002459 (OPEN 2021), covering eligibility, cost sharing, submission requirements, required forms, teaming, and IP/funding rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quiet period / communications prohibition
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon the issuance of this Funding Opportunity Announcement (FOA), ARPA-E Program Directors and other ARPA-E personnel are prohibited from communicating (in writing or otherwise) with Applicants, or potential Applicants regarding the FOA. This “quiet period” remains in effect until ARPA-E’s public announcement of its project selections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants may submit questions only to ARPA-E-CO@hq.doe.gov (FOA name/number in subject). Questions about ARPA-E eXCHANGE go to ExchangeHelp@hq.doe.gov. ARPA-E will not accept or respond to other means (fax, telephone, mail, hand delivery); e-mails to other addresses will be disregarded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant self-assessment; ARPA-E will not pre-assess proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: ARPA-E will not pre-assess an applicant’s proposal. Prospective applicants must review the technical requirements of the FOA and independently determine whether their proposed concept warrants a submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not expect ARPA-E to pre-validate fit, TRL appropriateness, or category assignment; applicants should refer to FOA sections I.A, I.D and other technical descriptions to choose Category/Subcategory and judge competitiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category and Subcategory selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must choose the appropriate Category and Subcategory for their submission based on technical descriptions in the Categories and/or Subcategories provided in the FOA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The choice organizes submissions for merit review. If technology does not fall within listed subcategories, select Category 7, Subcategory L (Other Energy Technologies Not Listed Above). See OPEN 2021 FAQs 7 and 9 for examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concept Paper content — Team Organization and Capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Concept Paper Section IV.C.1.d: TEAM ORGANIZATION AND CAPABILITIES must identify the Project Team.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Project Team needs to be identified as outlined in FOA Section III.A (Eligible Applicants). The eXCHANGE system allows expansion/modification of the Project Team for Full Applications, but team identification is required at Concept Paper stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility and award recipient rules
rubrics_metrics.description: ARPA-E accepts applications from U.S. citizens or permanent residents in their individual capacity, but awards Federal financial assistance to domestic institutions, not individuals. Foreign entities may apply as Standalone Applicants, lead organizations, or members of Project Teams (subject to FOA Section III.A.3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Whether an individual (e.g., foreign national on visa) may participate depends on facts (immigration, export control, agreement terms); applicants should consult institutional counsel and FOA Section III.A for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resubmission and multiple submissions policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Resubmission of previously unfunded concepts is permitted. Applicants may submit more than one application to this FOA, provided that each application is scientifically distinct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A concept paper that was rejected in a targeted solicitation may be resubmitted to OPEN. The Concept Paper submit checkbox certifying scientific distinctness is a hard requirement and will not be removed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost share base requirements and reduction rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Cost sharing requirements are set forth in FOA Section III.B (including base 20% and reduced percentages for certain team compositions such as FFRDC involvement).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ARPA-E will not pre-assess cost share arrangements; prospective applicants must review FOA cost share requirements and 2 C.F.R. § 200.306 for federal standards on valuation of cost share. Specific eligibility for reduced percentages (e.g., 5%) depends on team composition per FOA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Valuation and allowable forms of cost share
rubrics_metrics.description: Federal standards for valuing cost share are in 2 C.F.R. § 200.306 and include personal compensation for project work not reimbursed by ARPA-E.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unpaid PI time may be considered cost share if not reimbursed. License fees or software provided by a third party may be cost share per 2 C.F.R. § 200.306(d). In-kind contributions must meet federal criteria; see FOA and cited CFR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of cost-share commitment timing and content
rubrics_metrics.description: Letters of Cost-Share Commitment are NOT REQUIRED at time of application submission; upon selection for award negotiations, the Prime must provide unconditional, signed cost share commitment letters from subrecipients or third parties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Letters must be on letterhead, signed by an authorized corporate representative, state amount and form of cost share, source and nature of contribution, duration and timing, and be unconditional and unequivocal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business Assurances & Disclosures Form requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants submitting a Full Application must disclose current and pending funding and complete the Business Assurances & Disclosures form; the Lead Prime Recipient is required to sign and submit the form on behalf of the Project Team or append team members' completed forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each Team Member should fully complete their form. The Business Assurances form must be completed even for FFRDCs; check FOA and the form instructions for required attachments (Authorization Letter, FWP documents) and who must complete which sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: SF-424A Budget Workbook and supporting documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must complete the Budget_Justification_SF-424A_Workbook and follow its tab instructions (e.g., Personnel, SF-424A fields, Fringe/Indirect tabs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original Date of Submission = date of full application. Award Number may be applicant Control Number. Resumes/Personal Qualification Summaries are required in the Technical Volume; supporting documentation (e.g., fringe/indirect rate docs, tuition proofs) should be uploaded as Additional Files on eXCHANGE. See FAQ answers for tab-specific guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resume and personal qualification summary handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal Qualification Summaries (resumes) are required as part of the Technical Volume. Resumes should NOT be submitted with the SF-424A workbook during the Merit Review stage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include resumes in the Technical Volume per FOA instructions; do not attach resumes to the Budget Workbook during merit review. Follow eXCHANGE upload instructions for Additional Files if needed later.

rubrics_metrics.name: No appendices or letters of support allowed
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendices are not allowed; letters of support should not be submitted as an appendix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must adhere to page limits and allowed attachments; appendices will not be accepted. See FOA for permitted attachments and format restrictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work performance and expenditure in United States
rubrics_metrics.description: All work under the ARPA-E award must be performed in the United States. Prime Recipients must expend 100% of the Total Project Cost in the United States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to FOA Section B. Administrative and National Policy Requirements — U.S. Competitiveness for details; see General FAQs 4.5 and 10.15 for related examples (e.g., whether equipment purchased outside US can be cost share).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-award costs and funding restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Pre-award costs applicability is governed by FOA funding restrictions (Section G. Funding Restrictions 2. Pre-Award Costs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to FOA Section G for whether costs incurred before award can count toward cost share or be allowed; applicants asked about Aug 2021 pre-award costs were referred to that FOA section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subrecipient vs contractor determinations and subcontracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Subrecipient and contractor determinations must follow 2 C.F.R. § 200.331; contractors who incur more than 10% of project costs must submit a separate SF-424A worksheet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Whether an entity is a subrecipient or contractor affects cost share, reporting, and required forms. Applicants should review 2 C.F.R. § 200.331 and FOA instructions for subcontracting rules; no ARPA-E-imposed contract type (FP/T&M) restrictions are mandated beyond reasonableness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding flow to prime recipient
rubrics_metrics.description: ARPA-E funds are sent to the prime recipient, who then flows funds down to subcontractors as appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The prime recipient is financially responsible; plan budget flow and subaward paperwork accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technology-to-Market (T2M) plan timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission of a Technology-to-Market Plan is NOT required for a Full Application. Prime Recipients are required to submit an initial T2M plan to the ARPA-E Program Director during award negotiations and updated versions every six months through the project period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare to produce a T2M plan during negotiations if selected; it is not evaluated as part of the Full Application submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intellectual property disclosures and Title to Subject Inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must review FOA Section VIII.A (Title to Subject Inventions) regarding patents and government rights (including March-In-Rights).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technology-to-Market section should list all IP that will be leveraged; grouping patents by common denominator (technical area, agency, contract) is acceptable. Review FOA for specifics on government rights, protection of technical data, and patent-related award terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 5.1 Technical Volume — show Total Project Cost
rubrics_metrics.description: The 5.1 Table in the Technical Volume should show the breakdown by Task for Total Project Costs (TPC), not the Federal portion only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure budget tables correspond to Total Project Cost across tasks, matching the SF-424A workbook guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: File naming and upload behavior on ARPA-E eXCHANGE
rubrics_metrics.description: The ARPA-E Funding Opportunity Exchange website automatically renames files on upload.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow eXCHANGE upload rules and required file types; do not rely on original file names for reviewer reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadline and extension policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Application deadlines are firm; ARPA-E cannot extend application deadlines at its discretion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan submissions to meet posted deadlines; requests for extensions will generally be denied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contractor contribution and cost-share equivalence
rubrics_metrics.description: Contractors that incur more than 10% of project costs have similar reporting obligations (e.g., separate SF-424A) and may affect cost share expectations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a contractor (rather than subrecipient) is incurring >10% of project costs, treat reporting per FOA/Q&A (Yes, contractors in that situation must submit separate 424A). Cost share counting and percent requirements should be determined per FOA rules and 2 C.F.R. §200.306.
